items.docs: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint that returns a standard completion plus a Cleanlab trustworthiness score. Point the OpenAI client base_url at https://api.cleanlab.ai/api/v1/openai_trustworthy_llm/ and the client appends /v1/chat/completions automatically. The trustworthiness score (0-1) is returned in tlm_metadata on the response. Set stream=true to receive the completion as Server-Sent Events; the final SSE chunk carries the tlm_metadata.
